agc_driver_graphics undefined UBSan stops on the misaligned guest word loads of the ASan build's CopyGuestBytes (Execution/src/GuestMemory.cpp), which #10973 fixes, and then on Graphics/src/DepthSurface.cpp:730, which binds a TextureDetiler reference to a null pointer when the context has no detiler.
agc_driver_graphics_maps_fallback undefined UBSan stops on the misaligned guest word loads of the ASan build's CopyGuestBytes (Execution/src/GuestMemory.cpp), which #10973 fixes, and then on Graphics/src/DepthSurface.cpp:730, which binds a TextureDetiler reference to a null pointer when the context has no detiler.
agc_driver_pm4 undefined UBSan stops on the misaligned guest word loads of the ASan build's CopyGuestBytes (Execution/src/GuestMemory.cpp); #10973 fixes them.
agc_performance_overlay address,undefined Runs past its 30 s ctest TIMEOUT in the sanitizer build on ubuntu-latest (timed out at 30.18 s); it passes without sanitizers, and alone it takes about 19 s; #11555 gives it 120 s in ASan builds.
guest_backtrace address Fails only in ASan builds, with 'guest backtrace: first frame is not in the calling module', because the sanitizer adds a frame to backtrace(); #9240 starts the frames at the caller.
guest_getrlimit address The test lowers RLIMIT_DATA to 1 TiB, below the private memory ASan has already mapped, so ASan's next internal mapping fails with ENOMEM ('failed to allocate ... DTLS_NextBlock').
guest_math address,undefined ubuntu-latest's GCC 15 targets x86-64-v3 and fuses libc's float multiply-adds into FMA, so atanf misses the console bits by one ulp; #11059 builds libc with -ffp-contract=off.
guest_vorbis_dec undefined The bundled libvorbis left-shifts a negative value (3rdparty/vorbis/lib/psy.c:319); #11480 updates libvorbis to the upstream fix.
